run_metadata.coverage_summary: Tier-1 government portals (AusTender/Defence, buy.nsw, Buying for Victoria, QTenders/supply.qld, Tenders WA, Tenders SA, Tenders Tasmania, NT QTOL, Tenders ACT) were queried via WebSearch across all jurisdictions. Tier-2 (airport/port/water GBEs, universities/CSIRO, NSW Health/HealthShare) and Tier-3 (SAP Ariba Discovery, Jaggaer/GEP/Ivalua, BHP/Rio/Woodside, EstimateOne construction) were scanned, and dedicated source-discovery searches were run for new/rebranded portals. TWO HARD LIMITS applied this run: (1) the session network policy blocks outbound DNS to every external domain, so every WebFetch returned 'getaddrinfo ENOTFOUND' and NO tender detail page or document could be opened - everything is headline-level from WebSearch summaries only; (2) the search index returned predominantly stale/cached pages (closing dates clustered Feb-Aug 2026) dominated by paid aggregators, so current (Nov 2026) buyer-originated portal listings were largely not recoverable. Only one still-open buyer-originated opportunity could be re-confirmed this run (Defence LAND 6504 EOI, closes 26 Nov 2026). No new sources could be confirmed - every source-discovery candidate surfaced this run (AusTender GovPanels Supplier Portal, ICN Gateway, NHVR, supply.qld/VendorPanel, Mount Alexander & East Gippsland councils on VendorPanel) is already in the known source set. No opportunities, sources, dates, values or contacts were fabricated.
gaps: CRITICAL - NETWORK: The session network policy blocks outbound DNS to all external domains. Every WebFetch (tenders.gov.au and all others) returned 'getaddrinfo ENOTFOUND'. Consequently NO tender detail page or document could be opened or verified this run: the single captured entry is headline-level from WebSearch summaries only, and deliverables, requirements, evaluation criteria, documents, exact values, submission mechanics and contacts could not be obtained. These domains must be allow-listed in the session network settings for a verified run.

SEARCH INDEX STALE: Tier-1 portals (buy.nsw, Buying for Victoria, QTenders/supply.qld, Tenders WA, Tenders SA, Tenders Tasmania, NT QTOL, Tenders ACT) returned almost entirely stale/cached listings via WebSearch (closing dates in Feb-Aug 2026). Current November 2026 portal summaries were not recoverable through the search index, so current opportunities on those portals could not be confirmed and were not recorded. Deferred to a future run or an allow-listed/authenticated session.

Tenders SA search returned almost entirely South African (tenders.sa / SANRAL / Tenderflow) results, not South Australian; no SA opportunity could be confirmed. NT QTOL and ACT returned only pre-November or aggregator-only items.

Tier-2 (airport/port corporations, Water Corporation/South East Water/Sydney Water, universities/CSIRO, NSW Health/HealthShare/LHDs): only closed (pre-November 2026) opportunities or aggregator-only listings surfaced; no current opportunity could be confirmed buyer-originated. Water utilities (Sydney Water SAP Ariba) and university procurement are predominantly registration/login-gated.

Tier-3 corporate (MANDATORY scan performed): SAP Ariba Discovery, Jaggaer/GEP/Ivalua, and major-buyer portals (BHP/Rio Tinto/Woodside/Fortescue/Santos; Woolworths/Coles; CBA/Westpac/NAB/ANZ; Telstra/Optus; AGL/Origin; Qantas) returned no publicly-visible open RFx via WebSearch. Posting boards are registration-gated and buyer-specific events are often invitation-only (out of scope). All relevant corporate portals are already recorded in discovered_sources from prior runs; no corporate tenders were fabricated.

SOURCE DISCOVERY attempted but no NEW source confirmed: candidates surfaced this run (AusTender GovPanels/Supplier Portal, ICN Gateway, NHVR procurement, supply.qld/Queensland Procurement Solution on VendorPanel, Mount Alexander Shire & East Gippsland Shire councils migrating to VendorPanel, Logan City Council) are all already in the known 489-source set. The search index surfaced no genuinely new buyer-originated portal or rebrand this run.

Aggregator-only signals (NOT recorded as confirmed tenders, per the buyer-originated rule): higher-numbered australiantenders.com.au listings suggesting recent activity, e.g. 'Whitsunday Coast Airport (WCA) Sewage System - Operate and Maintain' (issuer Whitsunday Regional Council, listing 619019) and 'Superintendent and Principal Representative Services PSP002-011' (listing 616582). The buyer's own source could not be reached (DNS blocked) to confirm currency/detail, so these are left as discovery signals only and not captured.

tenders.title: LAND 6504 - Army Medium-Range Ground-Based Air and Missile Defence System (EOI)
tenders.buyer: Department of Defence - Capability Acquisition and Sustainment Group (CASG)
tenders.category: Defence - air and missile defence capability
tenders.description: Expression of Interest for the Australian Army's medium-range ground-based air and missile defence capability (project LAND 6504). Opened 13 October 2026 under AusTender ATM ID AIR/EOI/102637/1; bids close 26 November 2026, 12:00 PM ACT local time. Reporting indicates a supplier is targeted to be selected by the end of 2027.
tenders.reasoning: Re-confirmed as still open via WebSearch (defence-sector news coverage plus the AusTender ATM ID AIR/EOI/102637/1) on this run's Defence/AusTender query. Buyer-originated via AusTender. Already tracked in the aggregate since 2026-11-01; recorded again to refresh last-seen because it remains open (closes 26 Nov 2026).
tenders.notes: HEADLINE-LEVEL ONLY (entries_pending_detail). The AusTender notice could not be opened to verify deliverables, requirements, evaluation criteria, value, submission mechanics or documents - tenders.gov.au is DNS-blocked in this session. Dates/ID taken from WebSearch summaries of the notice and sector news coverage; not yet verified against the primary notice.
